_note: Hotel pairs a person has ruled on, in both directions.
scripts/match-virtuoso-hotels.mjs decides duplicates from names and distance, and
there is a class of pair it cannot decide from either. Two Ritz-Carltons in the
same city read as one hotel and its fuller name; one desert resort 6.6 km from
the city pin our record carries reads as two hotels. Nothing in the strings or
the coordinates separates those cases, so they are separated here.
`notTheSame` blocks a merge the matcher would otherwise make. `sameHotel` forces
one it refuses — always because our record's coordinate is a region rather than a
property, which puts a genuine duplicate past the 25 km ceiling.
Both are keyed by our local id and the Virtuoso product id, never by name: names
change on every supplier sync, and a rule keyed to a name would quietly stop
applying the first time one did.

Every entry needs a reason. If you cannot write one, the pair belongs in
nameOnlyReview in the id-map instead — the matcher puts anything it will not
decide there, and leaving a record unmatched is always the safe answer.
A `sameHotel` entry overrules the country check as well as the distance one.
That is deliberate and it is why the reasons matter: the records it exists for
include corrupted copies whose country and coordinates are both wrong, where the
name is the only field on the record telling the truth.

notTheSame.why: Two Ritz-Carltons, 16.5 km apart: ours is the Uptown Dallas hotel, theirs is in Irving. Virtuoso carries only Las Colinas, so folding ours away would delete the Dallas property from the atlas entirely.
The same shape as Dallas — two Ritz-Carltons in one city, 11 km apart, and only the Financial Street one is in the feed.

notTheSame.theirs: Shangri-La China World Summit Wing, Beijing
notTheSame.why: Two hotels in one complex. The Summit Wing is the tower; China World Hotel is the original beside it. 2.2 km apart and sharing a name is exactly what makes this pair unresolvable without knowing the place.

Desaru Coast is a destination, not a hotel — several properties sit on it, and we carry One&Only Desaru Coast separately. The record is a stub for the place; merging it into Anantara would assert a booking that record never described.

sameHotel.why: One hotel, 66 km apart on paper because our record is geocoded to Samana province and the property is at Cabrera. The only ANI in the country.

sameHotel.theirs: Domes Zeen, A Luxury Collection Resort, Chania
sameHotel.why: Our city is 'Crete' — the island, not a place — so the pin lands 126 km from Chania. The name is unique in Greece.
Same island-as-city problem, 130 km. Phaea Blue is one hotel.
Our record says Holbox; Etéreo is on the Riviera Maya, 28 km past the ceiling. One of two stubs we carry for it.
The second stub for the same hotel, geocoded further out again at 102 km.

sameHotel.ours: Giza Palace - A Virtuoso Preview Property
sameHotel.why: The preview placeholder for the property Virtuoso now lists. 51 km apart because ours is pinned to Cairo Governorate rather than to Giza.
A zero for the letter O, and a pin dropped on Rhodes for a hotel in Christ Church, Barbados — 8,954 km out. Both fields that would normally decide this are wrong, so only the name is evidence.
The same import corruption as 02 Beach Club — an i for an l, and the SAME bogus Rhodes coordinate, for a resort in Marathon, Florida.

sameHotel.theirs: the DOUGLAS, an Autograph Collection Hotel
sameHotel.why: Identical name; the record was filed under Edinburgh, which is a plausible-looking guess for a Scottish name and is 7,064 km from the hotel in Vancouver.

sameHotel.theirs: The Retreat Costa Rica, Wellness Resort & Spa
sameHotel.why: 67 km apart because our record is pinned to Quepos on the Pacific coast and the hotel is inland at Atenas, Alajuela. One retreat of that name in the country.
Our city is 'North Malé Atoll', an atoll rather than a place, so the pin sits 50 km from Fari Islands. The only Ritz-Carlton in the Maldives.
Our city is 'New Mexico' — the state — putting it 30 km from the reserve at Raton. Its two siblings, Armendaris and Sierra Grande, merged on distance; this one fell just outside.

sameHotel.theirs: Zadún Los Cabos, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
sameHotel.why: 25.2 km apart, two hundred metres past the ceiling, because both records point at San José del Cabo rather than at the property.
